title: N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) PRISON STATISTICS - 2000 A total of 799 prisoners died in jails by natural and unnatural causes during 2000 in the country. Of 799 deaths, 729 were natural whereas 70 deaths were due to unnatural causes. Thus, natural deaths accounted for 91.2 percent of the total deaths. Uttar Pradesh reported highest number of 112 natural deaths during the year. This was followed by Maharashtra (102), Andhra Pradesh (76), Bihar (74), Tamil Nadu (70), Madhya Pradesh (48) and Orissa (45).
